title: THE ACCENT IS LIME YELLOW
why: His Q46 (2026-10-18): the accent for selected things and main buttons is lime yellow, whichever shade is most visible on the dark. #e6ff3d is 15:1 on the panel and the ink on it is 15:1. Rarity gold, warn amber, danger red and the extract teal stay as they are, so the accent never reads as one of them.
now: Main buttons, the selected tab and the focus ring are lime yellow instead of amber.

edits.anchor: #root input:not([type=range]):focus, #root textarea:focus{ border-color:var(--amber); outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(245,183,59,.22); }
edits.replacement: #root input:not([type=range]):focus, #root textarea:focus{ border-color:var(--amber); outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(230,255,61,.22); }

edits.anchor: box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 var(--tx-1), inset 0 -3px 0 var(--bar,transparent), 0 0 0 6px rgba(245,183,59,.22), 0 0 0 7px rgba(11,12,13,.6) !important; }
edits.replacement: box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 var(--tx-1), inset 0 -3px 0 var(--bar,transparent), 0 0 0 6px rgba(230,255,61,.22), 0 0 0 7px rgba(11,12,13,.6) !important; }

edits.anchor: if(w>c+20){ ctx.fillStyle='#f5b73b'; ctx.fillRect(x+c+4,y,Math.min(36,w*0.25),2); }   // the amber tick of the menu plate (ui6)
edits.replacement: if(w>c+20){ ctx.fillStyle='#e6ff3d'; ctx.fillRect(x+c+4,y,Math.min(36,w*0.25),2); }   // the amber tick of the menu plate (ui6)

edits.anchor: #root .deploy:hover:not(:disabled), #root #oc_btn:hover:not(:disabled), #root .ui-btn.pri:hover:not(:disabled){ background:#f7c25a; background-image:none; border-color:#f7c25a; color:var(--acc-ink); filter:none; box-shadow:none; }
edits.replacement: #root .deploy:hover:not(:disabled), #root #oc_btn:hover:not(:disabled), #root .ui-btn.pri:hover:not(:disabled){ background:#f0ff7a; background-image:none; border-color:#f0ff7a; color:var(--acc-ink); filter:none; box-shadow:none; }

// v28.xx (cw-limeacc), his Q46 (2026-10-18): the accent is lime yellow, the most visible shade on the dark. warn stays the old amber on purpose, so a warning is never the accent.
  tx_1:'#efe9dc', tx_2:'#aaa498', tx_3:'#7a766e', tx_off:'#55524c', acc:'#e6ff3d', acc_ink:'#11150a', acc_dim:'rgba(230,255,61,.16)',
